title: Disenchantment Course

{{Quest infobox | name = Disenchantment Course | map = | campaign = Factions | region = Shing Jea Island | nationality = Canthan | type = Secondary | solo = y | given by = [[Instructor Ng]] | given at = [[Shing Jea Monastery]] | part of = [[Necromancer Insignia]]
[[Mesmer Insignia]]
[[Assassin Insignia]] }} Advanced training for [[Cantha]]ns. Teaches how to remove [[enchantment]]s. == Quest information == === Requirements === {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | active = Any [[insignia quest]] }} * You must have [[Necromancer]], [[Mesmer]] or [[Assassin]] as your primary or secondary [[profession]]. === Objectives === * Speak with [[Mei Ling]]. * Speak with Mei Ling again to begin your test. * Battle [[Brother Pe Wan]]. * Speak with Mei Ling again. * See [[Instructor Ng]] for your reward. === Early benefits === Skills provided: * {{n}} {{skill icon|Strip Enchantment}} * {{me}} {{skill icon|Shatter Enchantment}} * {{a}} {{skill icon|Expunge Enchantments}} === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] == Walkthrough == You will have been provided with one or more skills that allows you to remove one or more enchantments from an enemy. Use these to strip Pe Wan of his elite skill. == NPCs == * {{Me}} 10 (20) [[Mei Ling]] * {{Mo}} 10 (20) [[Brother Pe Wan]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Instructor Ng :'', it is time to learn the art of Enchantment and Disenchantment. Knowing when you, your ally, or your foe is under an enchantment can be invaluable. Brother Pe Wan will assist us with this exercise. You will do battle with him, removing his Enchantments to increase your effectiveness.'' :''By accepting this quest you will abandon other advanced training quests and put yourself into a separate training arena from the rest of your party, if applicable.'' {{Offer dialog | accept = I am ready to learn. | decline = Enchantments do not interest me. | ask = Your enemies will employ Enchantments to sustain them. Learn how to negate their effects or remove them altogether as the next step in your training. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Mei Ling :''Brother Pe Wan will now enchant himself. Your task is to remove his Enchantments, which will weaken him to your attacks.'' ;Mei Ling :''Ready...begin!'' ;Mei Ling :''Good work. Now you know what an Enchantment looks like when it affects an ally or an opponent. Headmaster Amara predicted that you would pass this test, but do not get complacent; there is much more to learn. At least you have a good foundation, now.'' === Reward dialogue === ;Instructor Ng :''Well done, young apprentice. You have passed the Disenchantment course. Just remember, this is a skill that will improve with practice.'' == Notes == * [[Life Sheath]]'s functionality was [[Life_Sheath/Skill_history|redesigned]] since this quest was introduced making its removal rather ineffective; if stripped he will reapply it within two seconds, making the quest unusually difficult. ** It thus may be easier to take any ''fast'' rate of damage; if three hits are dealt every 2 seconds — one to trigger Life Sheath, one to redo what was healed, one to damage, then he will die eventually. ** If you are an assassin, try letting his life sheath absorb a normal attack after the first move of your combo, then you can finish your combo before the next life sheath. *** At level 10, with 5 points each in Dagger Mastery, Shadow Arts, and Critical Strikes, using Unsuspecting Strike, Fox Fangs, Twisting Fangs and Shroud of Distress, maintaining Shroud while using the attack skills (with the above in consideration) will ensure safe, but slow, completion. ** Taking skills that apply [[health degeneration]] such as [[Faintheartedness]], [[Life Siphon]], and [[Conjure Phantasm]] will negate the effects of Life Sheath altogether. * Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are [[Weh no Su]]. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
